deployment_roles.public_ingress: Union Core is the only public HTTP origin and owns public health, sessions, CSRF, Gateway policy, headers and ingress budgets.
deployment_roles.private_module: A supervised loopback worker declares private health in its Manifest and inherits public HTTP policy from Union; it has no direct live base URL.

requirements.summary: The public ingress exposes non-cached GET liveness; a private module instead declares a loopback supervisor-only liveness probe that no Gateway route covers.
The public ingress exposes dependency-aware GET readiness; a private module instead declares a loopback supervisor-only readiness probe surfaced through the authenticated platform catalog.
API errors expose a stable code plus a human-readable message after adapter normalization.
Session cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, scoped narrowly, and Secure on HTTPS.
Unsafe cookie-authenticated requests require a session-bound CSRF value.
Browser responses prevent MIME sniffing and framing and declare referrer/resource policy.
Request body bytes and receive time are bounded before business handlers.
Access and error logs redact credentials, cookies, CSRF values, and bearer tokens.
